CREATE TABLE embedded_documents ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, user_id UUID NOT NULL, chunk_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, embedding vector(1536) NOT NULL, year INT NOT NULL, month INT NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT uq_embedded_user_chunk UNIQUE(user_id, chunk_key) );
CREATE INDEX idx_embedded_user ON embedded_documents(user_id); CREATE INDEX idx_embedded_hnsw ON embedded_documents USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 64);
